svg.title: P31 intervention quotient compatibility
svg.desc: Theorem map for exact intervention-label descent, within-fiber response ambiguity, representative stability, and induced geometry uncertainty.
svg.text: P31 - Intervention-Quotient Compatibility
Several fine intervention labels may become one coarse label only when the induced response law is well defined.
DECLARED INTERVENTION QUOTIENT
Fine labels map to coarse labels
b: Uf → Uc
The map is surjective and the response space is fixed.
Label merging alone does not define a coarse response law.
EXACT DESCENT CRITERION
Responses must be constant on every fiber
b(u)=b(v) ⇒ P̄u,τ=P̄v,τ
The condition is necessary and sufficient.
Then the coarse response table is unique.
QUOTIENT AMBIGUITY
Residual response variation inside a fiber
ηb = supτ supb(u)=b(v) ||P̄u,τ-P̄v,τ||TV
ηb=0 ⇔ exact descent
Positive ηb means the quotient hides distinguishability.
REPRESENTATIVE DEPENDENCE WHEN EXACT DESCENT FAILS
Choose one fine representative s(c) from each quotient fiber
Qs(c,τ)=P̄s(c),τ
supc,τ ||Qs-Qs' ||TV ≤ ηb
The quotient ambiguity is the worst-case dependence on which fine intervention represents the coarse label.
INDUCED RESPONSE-GEOMETRY UNCERTAINTY
Pairwise coarse geometry inherits two representative errors
Gs(c,d,τ)=||Qs(c,τ)-Qs(d,τ)||TV
supc,d,τ |Gs-Gs'| ≤ 2ηb
At ηb=0 the quotient response geometry is representative independent.
INTERPRETATION GUARD
same coarse intervention label ≠ same physical actuator ≠ simultaneous intervention
P31 certifies operational response-law quotienting only within the declared experiment and retained delays.
BOUNDARY
P31 does not establish consciousness, physical completeness, actuator identity, intervention synergy, or time quotienting.
